LanguageData.CC_Settings_FaithLife_Tip: With Ideology: how firmly each colonist holds their faith comes into Rimfolk's life. Talks about faith can move a listener's certainty, the council can call an evening of faith or decree one faith for the colony, a hard turn of life can shake someone's faith, and a page shows who believes what and how firmly. Conversions are always the game's own: someone takes a new faith when their certainty runs out.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_FaithLife: Talks, rites and hard times can move a colonist's faith (Ideology).
